parts.t: The fastest way to reach me is by phone or text — most messages get a response the same day, often within a couple hours during business hours. Email works too, just slightly slower. When you message, give me a quick sense of what you're looking at: buying, selling, just starting to think about it, specific property in mind, timeline. The more context you give me, the more useful my first reply can be.

I work across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley. That includes Langley (City and Township), Surrey (Cloverdale, South Surrey, White Rock, Newton, Guildford, Fleetwood), Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Mission, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Delta (Ladner, Tsawwassen, North Delta), and parts of Burnaby, Coquitlam, and the Tri-Cities depending on the deal. If you're buying or selling somewhere outside that footprint and you want a referral to someone good, I'm happy to make the introduction
